dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.axial_tapering: Symmetric, gradual 2D geometric narrowing from the mid-body toward the posterior peduncle region.
dorsal_planar_contour_and_symmetry.planar_edge_undulation: Smooth, continuous lateral margins with no localized structural bulges or indentations visible along the skin-water interface.

surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.global_grayscale_baseline: Light-grey to off-white; high median pixel intensity consistent with sub-adult or adult skin tones, excluding specular highlights.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.mottling_density_and_topology: Low-density, diffuse, low-contrast grey patches visible primarily on the mid-to-posterior dorsal surface.
surface_reflectance_and_textural_phase.transition_boundaries: Diffuse gradient transitions between the pigmented mottled patches and the lighter baseline surface.

high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.localized_point_contrast_disruptions: High-contrast, dark circular aperture (blowhole) on the anterior dorsal midline; sparse, low-contrast punctate marks visible on the lower-left dorsal quadrant.
high_frequency_epidermal_anomalies.dorsal_surface_indentations: Shallow, longitudinal depression along the central dorsal axis posterior to the blowhole.
